notes.title: Queen Tiye
notes.content:

notes.content:

🌟 Preserving Nubian Heritage in Breakthrough Kemet X 🌟

With the help of Nubians living in Egypt and Sudan, we are proud to announce that characters in Breakthrough Kemet X will speak in the Nobiin language (also known as Halfawi in Southern Egypt and Sudan). This feature offers an authentic experience of Nubian heritage and culture.

Breakthrough Kemet X also incorporates the Kenzi dialect, enhancing your immersion and supporting the preservation of these important languages and cultures. Additionally, Nobiin script will be incorporated, bringing a deeper level of authenticity to your experience.

Coming soon to PC and VR Headsets via Virtual Desktop! 🎮


Ready to join the adventure? 🎮Immerse yourself in the rich history of Nubia with Breakthrough Kemet X. 🎮✨

notes.title: Partnership with the Nubian Language Society
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684909/0d78b4a80da4c9c7bdfd69bc9afa0e9bab6dbb93.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684909/bb4b7dc82e15c1646e1788d6115dee5d9aadf8b9.png[/img][/url]

At Theonel Studios, we're proud of our ongoing collaboration with the Nubian Language Society (NLS) to bring the rich heritage of Nubian languages into our game, Breakthrough: Kemet X. This partnership is a testament to our commitment to preserving and celebrating Nubian intangible heritage.

🎮🌟 With the invaluable support of NLS, the Nobiin language, especially the Halfawi dialect, is beautifully integrated into the immersive world of Kemet X. This initiative not only enriches the gaming experience but also highlights the cultural significance of the Nubian language.

🤝💬 Our dedication extends further as we collaborate with Nubians living in Aswan, Egypt, and Sudan to incorporate the Kenzi language into the game. This ensures a truly authentic and inclusive representation of Nubian culture and history within our digital landscapes.

🛡️🌐 These languages and cultures are endangered, and our efforts are part of a larger mission to preserve and celebrate the rich Nubian heritage before it's lost. By bringing these elements into our game, we aim to raise awareness and appreciation for the Nubian culture.

Learn more about the incredible work of the Nubian Language Society at [www.nlsnubia.com](http://www.nlsnubia.com).

Join us as we continue this incredible journey of cultural preservation and innovation. Together, we're making history come alive in the digital world! 🌟🎮

notes.title: Nubian Pharaoh Taharqa
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684909/5aa54bc52e773195c85c12d94b50dd848dc94046.jpg[/img]Immerse yourself in the profound legacy of Pharaoh Taharqa with "Breakthrough: Kemet X - Episode 1: Jaraqo's Dream." This game intricately blends the rich tapestry of ancient African history with the immersive power of modern gaming, inviting players to explore a narrative deeply rooted in our world's heritage. 🌍✨

The loading screen, featuring Pharaoh Taharqa of the 25th Dynasty, not only captivates with its visual depiction but also enriches the player's understanding of Nubian and Egyptian interconnections. Taharqa's reign, marked by his architectural contributions and the notable battle with the Assyrians, is further illuminated by an evocative quote from the Book of Isaiah, highlighting the rare intersection of archaeological and biblical evidence. 🏛️📖

In guiding you through Taharqa's monumental legacies, the game introduces Nobiin translations, bridging past and present, and suggests exploration of real-world locations such as the Nubian Museum in Aswan and the British Museum. These elements are not mere details; they are invitations to witness the enduring impacts of Taharqa’s reign across Sudan and Egypt, encouraging a deeper appreciation of a historically significant yet often overlooked era. 🗺️🔍

"Breakthrough: Kemet X" is more than a game; it is a platform for education and exploration. It challenges players to see beyond the surface, engaging with the complexities of ancient civilizations and their lasting influences on our modern world. 🎮📚

Join us in honoring the legacy of Pharaoh Taharqa and the rich history of ancient Africa with "Breakthrough: Kemet X." Delve into a game where history is not just told but experienced, and where each player's journey is a step towards understanding the profound interconnectedness of our shared past. 💫🌿
